title: Component Handbook: Lightweight Examples, Migration Kit, and Do/Don't Patterns
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a compact, actionable handbook entry for Tokens, Buttons, Tables, and Charts that lives on the docs site as a lightweight migration kit. The goal is to give engineers and product teams: 1) clear semantic token mappings (old -> new), 2) short before/after code snippets for common component API changes, 3) explicit do/don't usage guidelines and accessibility notes, and 4) a minimal migration checklist and compatibility shim recommendations. This ticket is scoped to authoring content, producing small examples, and wiring preview pages for the docsite. Implementation of shims or runtime helpers is tracked in ENG-2145.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Docs page added under /components/handbook with sections: tokens, buttons, tables, charts, migration-checklist
A2: Each component section has at least three short examples: canonical usage, a common anti-pattern ("do not"), and a migration snippet (old -> new)
A3: Semantic token mapping table present and downloadable (CSV link to Drive), and named clearly with legacy token key and recommended replacement
A4: Accessibility notes included for each component (keyboard, aria roles, color contrast), and examples validated by the accessibility engineer
A5: Docs page reviewed and approved by PM (Jonah Kim) and Eng reviewer (Priya Nair), with sign-off recorded in comments
A6: Staging preview link available and tested on mobile/desktop breakpoints
